FTII Itanagar students suspend classes over alleged assault, demand security

Students at the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) in Itanagar have suspended classes following an alleged assault on student Dominic Sangma. The students are demanding the deployment of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) and improved safety measures on campus. The alleged assault led to the immediate halt of academic activities. The students' demands focus on ensuring their security and preventing future incidents.
